pt.L: Obedeçam aos que os lideram e cedam [a eles], pois eles ficam acordados cuidando das almas de vocês como [quem] vai prestar contas, para que façam isso com alegria e não suspirando; pois isso não [seria] vantajoso para vocês.
pt.B: Sigam os seus líderes e submetam-se a eles. Eles ficam acordados cuidando das almas de vocês, como quem terá de prestar contas por elas. Façam com que eles possam fazer isso com alegria, e não suspirando, porque isso não traria nenhum proveito a vocês.
pt.R: Ouçam os líderes de vocês e façam o que eles dizem. Eles estão sempre cuidando de vocês e zelando por vocês, porque vão ter de contar a Deus como fizeram o seu trabalho. Ajudem os líderes a fazer esse trabalho com alegria, e não com tristeza. Se eles ficarem tristes, isso não vai ajudar vocês em nada.

decisions.choice: obey: follow, let yourselves be persuaded by
decisions.reason: Πείθεσθε means to be persuaded and so to follow. These are the present leaders, unlike those of verse 7. The author uses the same verb of himself in verse 18 ("we are persuaded").

decisions.choice: keep watch: stay awake on guard, like a shepherd or a sentry
decisions.reason: ἀγρυπνοῦσιν is literally to go without sleep. The picture is of watchful care.

decisions.choice: souls: your lives, your whole selves
decisions.reason: As in 10:39, the soul is the whole person whom God saves.

decisions.choice: will give an account: to God
decisions.reason: The phrase is the one used in 4:13 of God, "to whom we must give account". The leaders will answer to God for those in their care.

decisions.choice: unprofitable for you: it would do you real harm (an understatement)
decisions.reason: ἀλυσιτελὲς means "of no advantage". Saying less than is meant makes the point more strongly.

decisions.choice: tell God how they did their work (R)
decisions.reason: Readable says to whom the account is given, following the meaning decision.

decisions.choice: Wafuateni (L, B); Wasikilizeni (R)
decisions.reason: The verb is to be persuaded and so to follow (m1). "Kufuata" keeps that sense better than "kutii", the plain word for obedience.

source.text: Προσεύχεσθε περὶ ἡμῶν, πειθόμεθα γὰρ ὅτι καλὴν συνείδησιν ἔχομεν, ἐν πᾶσιν καλῶς θέλοντες ἀναστρέφεσθαι.

records.literal_gloss: Pray concerning us; we are persuaded for that a good conscience we have, in all things well wishing to conduct ourselves.

en.L: Pray for us; for we are persuaded that we have a good conscience, wishing to conduct ourselves well in all things.
en.B: Keep praying for us. We are confident that our conscience is good, since we want to live rightly in every way.
en.R: Pray for us. We believe that we have nothing to feel guilty about. We want to do what is right in everything.

es.L: {{plural_you:Oren|Orad}} por nosotros; pues estamos persuadidos de que tenemos una conciencia buena, queriendo comportarnos bien en todas las cosas.
es.B: {{plural_you:Sigan orando|Seguid orando}} por nosotros. Estamos seguros de que nuestra conciencia es buena, porque queremos vivir rectamente en todo.
es.R: {{plural_you:Oren|Orad}} por nosotros. Creemos que no tenemos nada de qué sentirnos culpables. Queremos hacer lo correcto en todo.

fr.L: Priez pour nous ; car nous sommes convaincus que nous avons une bonne conscience, désirant en toutes choses vivre comme il faut.
fr.B: Continuez à prier pour nous. Nous avons la conviction que notre conscience est nette, puisque nous voulons vivre droitement en toute chose.
fr.R: Priez pour nous. Nous pensons n’avoir rien à nous reprocher. Nous voulons faire ce qui est bien en toutes choses.

sw.L: Endeleeni kutuombea; kwa maana tumeshawishika ya kuwa dhamiri yetu ni njema, tukitaka kuenenda kwa uzuri katika kila jambo.
sw.B: Msiache kutuombea. Tuna hakika kwamba dhamiri yetu ni safi, kwa kuwa tunataka kuishi ipasavyo kwa kila namna.
sw.R: Tuombeeni. Tuna hakika kwamba hatuna jambo lolote la kutufanya tujione na hatia. Tunataka kufanya lililo sawa katika kila jambo.

vi.L: Hãy cầu nguyện cho chúng tôi; vì chúng tôi tin chắc rằng mình có lương tâm tốt, muốn sống cách tốt đẹp trong mọi sự.
vi.B: Hãy cứ cầu nguyện cho chúng tôi. Chúng tôi tin chắc rằng lương tâm mình trong sạch, vì chúng tôi muốn sống ngay thẳng trong mọi việc.
vi.R: Hãy cầu nguyện cho chúng tôi. Chúng tôi tin rằng mình không có điều gì phải cảm thấy có lỗi. Chúng tôi muốn làm điều đúng trong mọi việc.

ko.L: 우리를 위하여 기도해 주십시오. 우리는 모든 일에서 바르게 살기를 원하며, 선한 양심을 가지고 있다고 확신합니다.
ko.B: 계속 우리를 위하여 기도해 주십시오. 우리는 모든 일에서 바르게 살기를 원하므로, 우리의 양심이 선하다고 확신합니다.
ko.R: 우리를 위하여 기도해 주십시오. 우리는 부끄러울 것이 없다고 믿습니다. 우리는 모든 일에서 옳은 일을 하기를 원합니다.

pt.L: Orem por nós; pois estamos persuadidos de que temos boa consciência, querendo nos comportar bem em todas as coisas.
pt.B: Continuem orando por nós. Estamos certos de que a nossa consciência é boa, pois queremos viver de modo correto em tudo.
pt.R: Orem por nós. Nós acreditamos que não temos nada de que nos sentir culpados. Queremos fazer o que é certo em tudo.

decisions.choice: we: the author, perhaps with companions
decisions.reason: The author says "we" here and "I" in the next verse (as in 11:32). The plural may include coworkers, or it may be the author's modest way of speaking.

decisions.choice: a good conscience: knowing oneself free of wrongdoing
decisions.reason: Hebrews speaks of a conscience cleansed by Christ (9:14; 10:22). The author may be answering some criticism of his conduct, but he does not say.

decisions.choice: have nothing to feel guilty about (R)
decisions.reason: Readable says what a good conscience is in plain words.

decisions.choice: tumeshawishika (L); Tuna hakika (B, R)
decisions.reason: The verb is the one translated "follow" in verse 17 (m1 there). "Kuamini" is kept for faith and believing, so the author's confidence is "kushawishika" or "kuwa na hakika".

source.text: περισσοτέρως δὲ παρακαλῶ τοῦτο ποιῆσαι ἵνα τάχιον ἀποκατασταθῶ ὑμῖν.

records.literal_gloss: More abundantly now I urge this to do, so that more quickly I may be restored to you.

en.L: And I urge [you] all the more to do this, so that I may be restored to you more quickly.
en.B: And I ask you even more earnestly to do this, so that I may be brought back to you all the sooner.
en.R: I am asking you even more to pray for me. Then I may be able to come back to you sooner.

es.L: Y con mayor insistencia {{plural_you:les|os}} exhorto a hacer esto, para que yo {{plural_you:les|os}} sea restituido más pronto.
es.B: Y {{plural_you:les|os}} pido con más empeño todavía que lo {{plural_you:hagan|hagáis}}, para que se me conceda volver con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} cuanto antes.
es.R: {{plural_you:Les|Os}} pido todavía con más fuerza que {{plural_you:oren|oréis}} por mí. Así tal vez pueda volver con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} más pronto.

fr.L: Et je [vous] exhorte d’autant plus à faire cela, afin que je vous sois rendu plus rapidement.
fr.B: Et je vous le demande avec plus d’insistance encore, pour que je puisse vous être ramené d’autant plus tôt.
fr.R: Je vous demande encore plus de prier pour moi. Ainsi, je pourrai revenir plus vite chez vous.

sw.L: Na ninawahimiza zaidi kabisa mfanye jambo hili, ili nipate kurejeshwa kwenu mapema zaidi.
sw.B: Tena nawaomba kwa bidii zaidi mfanye hivyo, ili niletwe tena kwenu mapema iwezekanavyo.
sw.R: Nawaomba hata zaidi mniombee. Ndipo huenda nikaweza kurudi kwenu mapema zaidi.

vi.L: Và tôi càng nài khuyên [anh chị em] làm điều này, để tôi sớm được trở về với anh chị em.
vi.B: Tôi càng tha thiết xin anh chị em làm điều này, để tôi sớm được đem trở về với anh chị em.
vi.R: Tôi càng xin anh chị em cầu nguyện cho tôi. Như vậy tôi có thể sớm trở về với anh chị em.

ko.L: 그리고 내가 여러분에게 더 빨리 돌아갈 수 있도록, 이렇게 하기를 더욱 권합니다.
ko.B: 그리고 내가 여러분에게 더 빨리 돌아갈 수 있도록 이 일을 해 주기를 더욱 간곡히 부탁합니다.
ko.R: 나를 위하여 더욱 기도해 주기를 부탁합니다. 그러면 내가 여러분에게 더 빨리 돌아갈 수 있을 것입니다.

pt.L: E exorto [vocês] ainda mais a fazerem isso, para que eu lhes seja restituído mais depressa.
pt.B: E peço a vocês com mais insistência ainda que façam isso, para que eu possa ser trazido de volta a vocês o quanto antes.
pt.R: Peço ainda mais que vocês orem por mim. Assim talvez eu possa voltar para junto de vocês mais cedo.

decisions.choice: I: the author alone
decisions.reason: The author knows the readers and has been with them before. The letter does not say who the author is.

decisions.choice: be restored to you: be brought back to you
decisions.reason: ἀποκατασταθῶ means to be given back or restored. Something is keeping the author away; the letter does not say what (verse 23 suggests the author is free to travel).

decisions.choice: to pray for me (R)
decisions.reason: "This" refers to the prayer asked for in verse 18; Readable says so.

decisions.choice: "tôi" for the writer alone, after "chúng tôi" in 13:18
decisions.reason: In 13:18 the writer speaks perhaps with companions, "chúng tôi"; here he speaks alone (m1), so Vietnamese moves to "tôi", as the Greek moves to "I".

source.text: Ὁ δὲ θεὸς τῆς εἰρήνης, ὁ ἀναγαγὼν ἐκ νεκρῶν τὸν ποιμένα τῶν προβάτων τὸν μέγαν ἐν αἵματι διαθήκης αἰωνίου, τὸν κύριον ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦν, καταρτίσαι ὑμᾶς ἐν παντὶ ἀγαθῷ εἰς τὸ ποιῆσαι τὸ θέλημα αὐτοῦ, ποιῶν ἐν ἡμῖν τὸ εὐάρεστον ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ διὰ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ, ᾧ ἡ δόξα εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας· ἀμήν.

records.literal_gloss: The now God of the peace, the having brought up out of dead the shepherd of the sheep the great by blood of covenant eternal, the Lord of us Jesus, \v 21 may equip you in every good for to do the will of him, doing in us the well-pleasing before him through Jesus Christ, to whom the glory to the ages; amen.

en.L: Now may the God of peace, who brought up out of [the] dead the shepherd of the sheep, the great [one], by [the] blood of an eternal covenant, our Lord Jesus, \v 21 equip you in every good [thing] to do {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} will, doing in us what is pleasing before {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} through Jesus {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}, to whom [be] the glory to the ages. Amen.
en.B: May the God of peace, who led our Lord Jesus, the great shepherd of the sheep, up from the dead through the blood of an eternal covenant, \v 21 make you ready in every good thing for doing {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} will. May {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} bring about in us whatever pleases {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, through Jesus {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}. To {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} be the glory for all the ages. Amen.
en.R: God gives peace. He brought our Lord Jesus back from the dead. Jesus is the great shepherd of the sheep, and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} blood sealed an eternal covenant. \v 21 May God give you every good thing you need to do what {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} wants. May {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} work in us what pleases {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, through Jesus {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}. May {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} have the glory for all the ages! Amen.

es.L: Y que el Dios de la paz, que sacó de entre [los] muertos al pastor de las ovejas, el grande, por [la] sangre de un pacto eterno, a nuestro Señor Jesús, \v 21 {{plural_you:los|os}} capacite en todo [lo] bueno para hacer {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} voluntad, haciendo en nosotros lo que es agradable delante de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} por medio de Jesús {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}}, a quien [sea] la gloria por los siglos. Amén.
es.B: Que el Dios de la paz, que hizo subir de entre los muertos a nuestro Señor Jesús, el gran pastor de las ovejas, por medio de la sangre de un pacto eterno, \v 21 {{plural_you:los|os}} prepare con todo lo bueno para hacer {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} voluntad. Que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} produzca en nosotros todo lo que {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} agrada, por medio de Jesús {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}}. A {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} sea la gloria por todos los siglos. Amén.
es.R: Dios da paz. Él hizo volver de la muerte a nuestro Señor Jesús. Jesús es el gran pastor de las ovejas, y {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} sangre selló un pacto eterno. \v 21 Que Dios {{plural_you:les|os}} dé todo lo bueno que {{plural_you:necesitan|necesitáis}} para hacer lo que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} quiere. Que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} haga en nosotros lo que {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} agrada, por medio de Jesús {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}}. ¡Que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} reciba la gloria por todos los siglos! Amén.

fr.L: Or que le Dieu de la paix, qui a fait remonter d’entre [les] morts le berger des brebis, le grand, par [le] sang d’une alliance éternelle, notre Seigneur Jésus, \v 21 vous rende aptes en tout bien à faire {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} volonté, faisant en nous ce qui est agréable devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} par Jésus {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, à qui [soit] la gloire pour les siècles. Amen.
fr.B: Que le Dieu de la paix, qui a fait remonter d’entre les morts notre Seigneur Jésus, le grand berger des brebis, par le sang d’une alliance éternelle, \v 21 vous rende prêts, en toute chose bonne, à faire {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} volonté. Qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} accomplisse en nous ce qui {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} plaît, par Jésus {{christos:Christ|le Messie}}. À {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} soit la gloire pour tous les siècles. Amen.
fr.R: Dieu donne la paix. Il a ramené notre Seigneur Jésus de la mort à la vie. Jésus est le grand berger des brebis, et {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} sang a scellé une alliance éternelle. \v 21 Que Dieu vous donne toutes les bonnes choses dont vous avez besoin pour faire ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} veut. Qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} fasse en nous ce qui {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} plaît, par Jésus {{christos:Christ|le Messie}}. Qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} reçoive la gloire pour tous les siècles ! Amen.

sw.L: Basi Mungu wa amani, yule aliyempandisha kutoka kwa wafu mchungaji wa kondoo, aliye mkuu, katika damu ya agano la milele, Bwana wetu Yesu, \v 21 na awatengeneze katika kila [jambo] jema ili mtende mapenzi {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, akitenda ndani yetu kile kinachopendeza mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} kupitia Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, ambaye {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}} [na uwe] utukufu hadi zama zote. Amina.
sw.B: Mungu wa amani, aliyemrudisha kutoka kwa wafu Bwana wetu Yesu, mchungaji mkuu wa kondoo, kupitia damu ya agano la milele, \v 21 awaandae kikamilifu katika kila jambo jema ili mfanye mapenzi {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}. Na afanye ndani yetu lolote linalompendeza, kupitia Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}. Kwake uwe utukufu hata zama zote. Amina.
sw.R: Mungu ndiye anayetupa amani. Alimfufua Bwana wetu Yesu kutoka kwa wafu. Yesu ndiye mchungaji mkuu wa kondoo, na damu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} ilithibitisha agano la milele. \v 21 Mungu awape kila kitu kizuri mnachohitaji ili mfanye anachotaka. Na afanye kazi ndani yetu yale yanayompendeza, kupitia Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}. Apewe utukufu hata zama zote! Amina.

vi.L: Nguyện Đức Chúa Trời của sự bình an, là Đấng đã đem Đấng Chăn Chiên lớn của bầy chiên, là Chúa chúng ta, Đức Giê-xu, ra khỏi cõi chết bởi huyết của giao ước đời đời, \v 21 trang bị cho anh chị em mọi điều lành để làm theo ý muốn {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, thực hiện trong chúng ta điều đẹp lòng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} qua Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}}; nguyện vinh quang [thuộc về] {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đời đời. A-men.
vi.B: Nguyện Đức Chúa Trời của sự bình an, là Đấng bởi huyết của giao ước đời đời đã đem Chúa chúng ta là Đức Giê-xu, Đấng Chăn Chiên lớn của bầy chiên, sống lại từ cõi chết, \v 21 trang bị cho anh chị em mọi điều tốt lành để làm theo ý muốn {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Nguyện {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thực hiện trong chúng ta điều đẹp lòng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, qua Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}}. Nguyện vinh quang thuộc về {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đời đời. A-men.
vi.R: Đức Chúa Trời là Đấng ban sự bình an. Ngài đã khiến Chúa chúng ta là Đức Giê-xu sống lại từ cõi chết. Đức Giê-xu là Đấng Chăn Chiên lớn của bầy chiên, và huyết của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã ấn chứng một giao ước đời đời. \v 21 Cầu xin Đức Chúa Trời ban cho anh chị em mọi điều tốt lành anh chị em cần để làm theo ý {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} muốn. Cầu xin {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} làm trong chúng ta những điều đẹp lòng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, qua Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}}. Nguyện {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} được vinh quang đời đời! A-men.

ko.L: 영원한 언약의 피로 양들의 큰 목자이신 우리 주 예수를 죽은 사람들 가운데서 이끌어 올리신 평화의 하나님께서, \v 21 여러분을 모든 선한 일에 온전하게 하셔서 그분의 뜻을 행하게 하시고, 예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}를 통하여 그분 앞에서 기뻐하시는 것을 우리 안에 이루어 주시기를 빕니다. 영광이 그분께 영원무궁하도록 [있기를 빕니다]. 아멘.
ko.B: 평화의 하나님께서는 영원한 언약의 피로, 양들의 큰 목자이신 우리 주 예수를 죽은 사람들 가운데서 이끌어 올리셨습니다. \v 21 그 하나님께서 여러분을 모든 선한 일에 갖추어 주셔서 그분의 뜻을 행하게 하시기를 빕니다. 예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}를 통하여 그분이 기뻐하시는 일을 우리 안에 이루어 주시기를 빕니다. 그분께 영광이 영원히 있기를 빕니다. 아멘.
ko.R: 하나님은 평화를 주시는 분이십니다. 하나님께서는 우리 주 예수를 죽은 사람들 가운데서 다시 살리셨습니다. 예수께서는 양들의 위대한 목자이시고, 그분의 피로 영원한 언약이 세워졌습니다. \v 21 하나님께서 여러분에게 그분이 원하시는 일을 하는 데 필요한 모든 좋은 것을 주시기를 빕니다. 예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}를 통하여 하나님께서 기뻐하시는 일을 우리 안에서 이루어 주시기를 빕니다. 그분께 영원히 영광이 있기를 빕니다! 아멘.

pt.L: Ora, o Deus da paz, que fez subir dentre [os] mortos o pastor das ovelhas, o grande, pelo sangue de uma aliança eterna, o nosso Senhor Jesus, \v 21 equipe vocês em todo bem para fazerem a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} vontade, realizando em nós o que é agradável diante {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}} por meio de Jesus {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}}, a quem [seja] a glória pelas eras. Amém.
pt.B: Que o Deus da paz, que fez subir dentre os mortos o nosso Senhor Jesus, o grande pastor das ovelhas, pelo sangue de uma aliança eterna, \v 21 prepare vocês em todo bem para fazerem a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} vontade. Que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} realize em nós tudo o que {{deity_pronoun:lhe|Lhe}} agrada, por meio de Jesus {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}}. A {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} seja a glória por todas as eras. Amém.
pt.R: Deus dá a paz. Ele trouxe o nosso Senhor Jesus de volta dos mortos. Jesus é o grande pastor das ovelhas, e o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} sangue selou uma aliança eterna. \v 21 Que Deus dê a vocês todas as coisas boas de que precisam para fazer o que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} quer. Que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} faça em nós o que agrada a {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}, por meio de Jesus {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}}. Que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} receba a glória por todas as eras! Amém.

decisions.choice: the God of peace: God who gives peace and makes whole
decisions.reason: The title also closes letters in Romans 15:33, 16:20 and 1 Thessalonians 5:23. After warnings about strife and bitterness (12:14–15), the author prays to the God who makes peace.

decisions.choice: who brought up the shepherd of the sheep: Isaiah 63:11 (Greek)
decisions.reason: Isaiah 63:11 recalls God "who brought up from the sea the shepherd of the sheep", Moses at the Red Sea. Now God has brought up the greater shepherd from the dead. This is the clearest mention of Jesus' resurrection in Hebrews.

decisions.choice: by the blood of an eternal covenant: God raised Jesus on the ground of the covenant his blood made
alternatives: the great shepherd by virtue of his covenant blood
decisions.reason: The phrase may go with "brought up" or with "great shepherd". Either way, Jesus' blood seals an eternal covenant, as the prophets promised (Isaiah 55:3; Jeremiah 32:40; Ezekiel 37:26; compare Zechariah 9:11).

decisions.choice: equip: make complete, put in good order
decisions.reason: καταρτίσαι is used of mending nets (Mark 1:19) and of God putting the world in order (11:3).

decisions.choice: in every good thing (the SBLGNT reading)
alternatives: in every good work and word
decisions.reason: Many manuscripts add the word for "work", and some "work and word". The SBLGNT follows the shorter reading of several early manuscripts. Reviewers must check this against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: in us (the SBLGNT reading)
decisions.reason: Manuscripts are divided between ἡμῖν, "in us", and ὑμῖν, "in you"; the two words differed by one letter and sounded alike. Reviewers must check this against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: to the ages (the SBLGNT reading)
alternatives: to the ages of the ages, for ever and ever
decisions.reason: Many manuscripts read "to the ages of the ages", the usual longer form in such praises. The SBLGNT follows early manuscripts that have the shorter form. Reviewers must check this against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: to whom: God, or Jesus Christ
decisions.reason: God is the subject of the whole prayer, so the praise most likely goes to him (as in Romans 16:27). Jesus Christ is the nearer name, and praise is given to him in 2 Timothy 4:18. Balanced and Readable keep the ambiguity of "to him".

decisions.choice: the prayer split into wishes (B, R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable break the long Greek prayer into shorter sentences, each beginning "May".

decisions.choice: his blood sealed an eternal covenant (R)
decisions.reason: Readable makes the link between Jesus' blood and the covenant explicit, following the meaning decision.

decisions.choice: por los siglos (L); por todos los siglos (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Por los siglos" is the settled Spanish form of this closing praise (as at Romans 11:36), where it is heard as "for ever", not as hundreds of years. The same phrase stands at 13:8, so the two verses echo each other.

decisions.choice: awatengeneze (L); awaandae kikamilifu (B)
decisions.reason: The verb is to put in good order (m4). "Kukamilisha" is avoided because it is the book's word for "make perfect", a different Greek verb.

decisions.choice: ambaye kwake (L); Kwake (B); Apewe (R), the one praised left open
decisions.reason: The praise may go to God or to Jesus Christ (m8). "Kwake" and the passive "apewe" leave it open, as the Greek does.

decisions.choice: le berger des brebis
decisions.reason: "Pasteur" now means a minister first; "berger" keeps the picture of a shepherd with his sheep.

decisions.choice: "Đấng Chăn Chiên lớn của bầy chiên", capitalised; "A-men"; "Ngài" for "to whom"
decisions.reason: The shepherd of the sheep is Jesus (m2), so the title takes "Đấng" and capitals; "A-men" is the Protestant form, as in the Vietnamese Galatians (1:5). "Ngài" in the doxology may be God or Jesus Christ, as the meaning decision leaves open (m8).

decisions.choice: "평화의 하나님" for the God of peace; "그분께" for "to whom", as open as the Greek
decisions.reason: As in the Korean Romans 16:20. The meaning decision leaves open whether the glory is given to God or to Jesus Christ (uncertain, footnoted); Korean "그분께" can refer to either.

source.text: Παρακαλῶ δὲ ὑμᾶς, ἀδελφοί, ἀνέχεσθε τοῦ λόγου τῆς παρακλήσεως, καὶ γὰρ διὰ βραχέων ἐπέστειλα ὑμῖν.

records.literal_gloss: I urge now you, brothers, bear with the word of the exhortation, also for in few [words] I have written to you.

en.L: Now I urge you, {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}, bear with the word of exhortation, for indeed I have written to you in few [words].
en.B: {{gender:Brothers and sisters|Brothers}}, I urge you to put up with this message of encouragement; after all, I have written you only a short letter.
en.R: My {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}, I ask you to listen patiently to these words of encouragement. I have written you only a short letter.

es.L: Ahora bien, {{plural_you:les|os}} exhorto, hermanos: {{plural_you:toleren|tolerad}} la palabra de la exhortación, porque en efecto {{plural_you:les|os}} he escrito en pocas [palabras].
es.B: Hermanos, {{plural_you:les|os}} ruego que {{plural_you:acepten|aceptéis}} con paciencia este mensaje de aliento; al fin y al cabo, {{plural_you:les|os}} he escrito solo una carta breve.
es.R: Hermanos míos, {{plural_you:les|os}} pido que {{plural_you:escuchen|escuchéis}} con paciencia estas palabras de ánimo. {{plural_you:Les|Os}} he escrito solo una carta corta.

fr.L: Or je vous exhorte, {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}}, supportez la parole d’exhortation, car en effet je vous ai écrit en peu [de mots].
fr.B: {{gender:Frères et sœurs|Frères}}, je vous en prie, accueillez avec patience ce message d’encouragement ; après tout, je ne vous ai écrit qu’une courte lettre.
fr.R: Mes {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}}, je vous demande d’écouter avec patience ces paroles d’encouragement. Je ne vous ai écrit qu’une courte lettre.

sw.L: Basi nawasihi, ndugu, lichukulieni kwa uvumilivu neno la himizo, kwa kuwa kwa kweli nimewaandikia kwa ufupi.
sw.B: Ndugu, nawaomba mlipokee kwa uvumilivu neno hili la kuwatia moyo; hata hivyo nimewaandikia barua fupi tu.
sw.R: Ndugu zangu, nawaomba msikilize kwa uvumilivu maneno haya ya kuwatia moyo. Nimewaandikia barua fupi tu.

vi.L: Vậy, thưa {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}}, tôi nài khuyên anh chị em hãy kiên nhẫn nghe lời khuyên bảo này, vì tôi đã viết cho anh chị em cách vắn tắt.
vi.B: Thưa {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}}, tôi nài xin anh chị em hãy kiên nhẫn đón nhận sứ điệp khích lệ này, vì tôi chỉ viết cho anh chị em một bức thư ngắn.
vi.R: Thưa {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}} của tôi, tôi xin anh chị em hãy kiên nhẫn lắng nghe những lời khích lệ này. Tôi chỉ viết cho anh chị em một bức thư ngắn.

ko.L: {{gender:형제자매|형제}} 여러분, 내가 여러분에게 권합니다. 이 권면의 말씀을 참고 들어 주십시오. 내가 여러분에게 짧게 썼기 때문입니다.
ko.B: {{gender:형제자매|형제}} 여러분, 이 격려의 말씀을 너그럽게 받아 주기를 부탁합니다. 사실 나는 여러분에게 짧게 썼습니다.
ko.R: 나의 {{gender:형제자매|형제}} 여러분, 이 격려의 말을 참고 들어 주기를 부탁합니다. 나는 여러분에게 짧은 편지를 썼을 뿐입니다.

pt.L: Exorto vocês, {{gender:irmãos e irmãs|irmãos}}, a suportarem a palavra de exortação, pois de fato lhes escrevi em poucas [palavras].
pt.B: {{gender:Irmãos e irmãs|Irmãos}}, peço a vocês que recebam com paciência esta mensagem de encorajamento; afinal, escrevi a vocês apenas uma carta curta.
pt.R: Meus {{gender:irmãos e irmãs|irmãos}}, peço a vocês que ouçam com paciência estas palavras de encorajamento. Eu escrevi a vocês só uma carta curta.

decisions.choice: word of exhortation: a sermon of encouragement and appeal
decisions.reason: Acts 13:15 uses the same phrase for a sermon given in the synagogue after the reading of Scripture. The author describes Hebrews as such a sermon, sent in writing.

decisions.choice: briefly: in few words, given how much there is to say
decisions.reason: By the standard of a letter Hebrews is long, but the author has often held back (5:11; 9:5; 11:32). ἐπέστειλα is the regular word for sending a letter.

decisions.choice: bear with: accept patiently
decisions.reason: ἀνέχεσθε is to put up with something, here the warnings as well as the encouragement.

decisions.choice: exhortation (L); encouragement (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "exhortation", where the sense is a charge; Balanced and Readable say "encouragement", the book's usual wording.

decisions.choice: {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}
decisions.reason: The readers include women; "brothers" is the traditional alternative.

decisions.choice: "lời khuyên bảo" (L); "sứ điệp khích lệ" (B); "những lời khích lệ" (R)
decisions.reason: A word of exhortation is a sermon of encouragement and appeal (m1); Literal keeps "lời", Balanced and Readable say encouragement, as the English does.

source.text: γινώσκετε τὸν ἀδελφὸν ἡμῶν Τιμόθεον ἀπολελυμένον, μεθ’ οὗ ἐὰν τάχιον ἔρχηται ὄψομαι ὑμᾶς.

records.literal_gloss: Know the brother of us Timothy having been released, with whom if sooner he comes I will see you.

en.L: Know that our brother Timothy has been released, with whom, if he comes soon, I will see you.
en.B: You should know that our brother Timothy has been released. If he gets here soon enough, he will be with me when I see you.
en.R: I want you to know that our brother Timothy has been released. If he comes soon, I will bring him with me when I come to see you.

es.L: {{plural_you:Sepan|Sabed}} que nuestro hermano Timoteo ha sido puesto en libertad, con el cual, si viene pronto, {{plural_you:los|os}} veré.
es.B: {{plural_you:Deben|Debéis}} saber que nuestro hermano Timoteo ha sido puesto en libertad. Si llega pronto, estará conmigo cuando {{plural_you:los|os}} vea.
es.R: Quiero que {{plural_you:sepan|sepáis}} que nuestro hermano Timoteo ha sido liberado. Si viene pronto, lo llevaré conmigo cuando vaya a {{plural_you:verlos|veros}}.

fr.L: Sachez que notre frère Timothée a été remis en liberté ; avec lui, s’il vient assez tôt, je vous verrai.
fr.B: Vous devez savoir que notre frère Timothée a été libéré. S’il arrive assez tôt, il sera avec moi quand je vous verrai.
fr.R: Je veux que vous sachiez que notre frère Timothée a été libéré. S’il vient bientôt, je l’emmènerai avec moi quand je viendrai vous voir.

sw.L: Fahamuni kwamba ndugu yetu Timotheo ameachiliwa huru; yeye akija mapema, nitawaona nikiwa pamoja naye.
sw.B: Mnapaswa kujua kwamba ndugu yetu Timotheo ameachiliwa. Akifika hapa mapema vya kutosha, atakuwa pamoja nami nitakapowaona.
sw.R: Nataka mjue kwamba ndugu yetu Timotheo ameachiliwa. Akija mapema, nitakuja naye nitakapokuja kuwaona.

vi.L: Hãy biết rằng anh em chúng ta là Ti-mô-thê đã được thả ra; nếu anh ấy đến sớm, tôi sẽ cùng anh ấy đến thăm anh chị em.
vi.B: Anh chị em nên biết rằng anh em chúng ta là Ti-mô-thê đã được thả ra. Nếu anh ấy đến kịp, anh ấy sẽ cùng tôi đến thăm anh chị em.
vi.R: Tôi muốn anh chị em biết rằng anh em chúng ta là Ti-mô-thê đã được thả ra. Nếu anh ấy đến sớm, tôi sẽ đem anh ấy theo khi đến thăm anh chị em.

ko.L: 우리 형제 디모데가 풀려난 것을 아십시오. 그가 곧 오면, 내가 그와 함께 여러분을 보게 될 것입니다.
ko.B: 우리 형제 디모데가 풀려났다는 것을 알려 드립니다. 그가 곧 오면, 나는 그와 함께 여러분을 만나러 갈 것입니다.
ko.R: 우리 형제 디모데가 풀려났다는 것을 여러분이 알기 바랍니다. 그가 곧 오면, 나는 그를 데리고 여러분을 만나러 가겠습니다.

pt.L: Saibam que o nosso irmão Timóteo foi posto em liberdade; com ele, se vier logo, verei vocês.
pt.B: Vocês devem saber que o nosso irmão Timóteo foi libertado. Se ele chegar logo, estará comigo quando eu for ver vocês.
pt.R: Quero que vocês saibam que o nosso irmão Timóteo foi solto. Se ele vier logo, vou levá-lo comigo quando for visitar vocês.

decisions.choice: a command: know
decisions.reason: γινώσκετε can be read either way. As news it reads naturally as "know" or "I want you to know".

decisions.choice: released: most likely set free from prison
alternatives: sent off on a journey or mission
decisions.reason: ἀπολελυμένον is used both of release from prison and of sending someone away. No imprisonment of Timothy is recorded elsewhere.

decisions.choice: Timothy: most likely the coworker known from Acts 16:1–3 and Paul's letters
decisions.reason: The mention places the author in the same circle of early missionaries as Timothy (Philippians 2:19–23), but it does not identify the author, whom the letter never names.

decisions.choice: "anh em chúng ta là Ti-mô-thê"; "anh ấy" for Timothy
decisions.reason: Timothy is a male fellow worker (m3), so "anh em" here is a plain word with no gender span, and "anh ấy" is the pronoun the Vietnamese Colossians uses for a younger coworker.

source.text: ἀσπάσασθε πάντας τοὺς ἡγουμένους ὑμῶν καὶ πάντας τοὺς ἁγίους.

records.literal_gloss: Greet all those leading you and all the saints.

en.L: Greet all your leaders and all the saints.
en.B: Greet all your leaders and all God's holy people.

decisions.choice: those from Italy: either Italians away from home, or people in Italy
alternatives: Italians living outside Italy who send greetings home
believers in Italy sending greetings from there
decisions.reason: ἀπὸ can mark where people come from ("people who come from Italy") or where they are ("the people in Italy"). If the first, the author is outside Italy with Italian believers, and the letter may be going to Italy, perhaps to Rome. If the second, it is written from Italy. The earliest writing known to use Hebrews, 1 Clement, was sent from the church in Rome late in the first century.

decisions.choice: the letter ends without "Amen" (the SBLGNT reading)
decisions.reason: Most manuscripts add "Amen", as the King James Version has it; some early ones do not. Later manuscripts also add notes saying where the letter was written, which are not part of the text. Reviewers must check this against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: grace: God's free favor, the letter's closing wish
decisions.reason: The same short blessing closes Titus 3:15. Grace is where the letter has pointed throughout (4:16; 12:15; 13:9).
